Trump has been urged to launch a new major military campaign against Iran within eight weeks, before Democrats take control of Congress in January.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is reportedly pushing for renewed strikes, while Vice President JD Vance favors negotiations. 
Trump has approved military operations several times before canceling them shortly before launch.
Potential targets include Iran’s nuclear sites and oil and gas infrastructure. 
No final decision has been made.
Source: NBC News
